subtopic_title: Conversion of fractions to percentages and vice versa

candidate_atomic_objectives.proposed_objective_text: Calculate a percentage of a quantity.
candidate_atomic_objectives.evidence_quote: Calculate the value of the discount.
candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: These records ask learners to use a percentage to calculate a quantity or discount. That is a distinct applied percentage skill and is not covered by the canonical conversion objectives.
